personal care is a minor part of a mass-retail consumer goods business."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Owns personal care brands with skin care and sun care lines sold to the same mass and drug retailers as Coty."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Refrigerated pet food and treats, a pet food business with no beauty overlap."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Apparel, outerwear and footwear design and licensing, a fashion business rather than beauty products."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Packaged meat and prepared food processing, a protein and food business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Spices, seasonings and condiments for food makers and grocers, a food flavor business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Packaged beverages such as sparkling water and soft drinks, a beverage business."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Brand owner of professional and retail hair care sold to salons and consumers, matching Coty's professional hair business."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Apparel and lifestyle brands with restaurants, a fashion and hospitality business rather than beauty."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Household disposables such as foil, wrap and trash bags, a household goods business."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Canned and frozen vegetables and fruit, processed food rather than beauty."}]}
